customManagers.description: Tracks the vendored Scalar bundle (ledfx/api/v2/docs). Renovate only bumps SCALAR_VERSION; the scalar-vendored prek hook, run by autofix, rebuilds the bundle, its sha256, the licence and the ?v= in docs.html.

packageRules.description: The Scalar bundle runs on the LedFx origin: a person reviews each bump. Never automerge.
Windows CI is pinned to windows-2022 on purpose: windows-2025 has audio device issues (see ci.yml). Move it by hand once that is understood.
The compose file is an example users copy. Pinning :latest to a digest would freeze their image, so leave it alone.
sphinx-toolbox (docs/conf.py uses sphinx_toolbox.collapse) requires sphinx-autodoc-typehints<3.6.0, up to 4.3.1 at least. Lift this when sphinx-toolbox does.
Our own packages: released and reviewed by us, so no wait. Matches exclude-newer-package in pyproject.toml.
